notes.title: It's about time to explore Kamus!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! 

The wait is finally over – CUMVERSE [18+] is now live! Step into the role of the Empire’s chosen heir as you find yourself stranded on Kamus, a wild planet inhabited by alluring alien girls who think you’re their destined savior. 

Explore Kamus’s mysterious lands, hack into systems, spy on locals, and navigate tricky relationships as you uncover secrets and choose your path. Meet captivating characters like Cassia, the fierce rebel leader, and Uta, the half-breed with a unique perspective on the planet’s war. 

With hot scenes, detailed sci-fi visuals, and choices that matter, CUMVERSE is packed with action and temptation. Will you claim your place as “Great Alpha,” or will the world of Kamus pull you in another direction?

notes.title: Get ready – CUMVERSE [18+] is coming this weekend!
notes.notes:
[h3]Prepare to crash-land on the wild planet of Kamus, where lustful, alien girls and endless adventure await! In CUMVERSE, you’ll play as the Empire’s chosen heir, thrust into a world of rebellion, seductive encounters, and mysterious powers. After a ship crash leaves you stranded, you’ll explore Kamus, navigating challenges and relationships with the local Femians, who believe you’re sent by their gods.

Spy, hack, and build connections as you seek answers, forge alliances, and unlock secrets in a world where every choice shapes your destiny. Meet captivating characters like the rebellious Cassia, enigmatic half-breed Uta, and the fiery Empire princess, each one adding new twists to your journey.

[b]Wishlist the game now to be the first to experience the blend of sci-fi thrills, steamy 18+ scenes, and a richly interactive world. Your adventure begins soon – will you become the planet’s “Great Alpha”?[/b]

We can’t wait to see you play – get ready for the ultimate cosmic seduction! [/h3]
